name: Judson Colbert
description: Caden's older brother. Part of the regular McDonald's trio with CJ Tomford in 2016. Appeared on the NYC class trip. The older-sibling layer of the same CFA families JD had grown up alongside.
public_footprint:
A SUNY Potsdam news article (2017, honoring Chancellor Nancy Zimpher) names Judson Colbert as the boyfriend of art student Cashlynn Jaggers, noting he would begin studies at SUNY Canton that fall.
Sources: https://www.potsdam.edu/news/suny-potsdam-art-student-paints-commissioned-work-honor-chancellor-nancy-l-zimpher
